paper.title: Beyond UCB: Optimal and Efficient Contextual Bandits with Regression Oracles

settings.name_in_paper: Realizable contextual bandits with online regression oracle (adversarial contexts)
unmapped: realizability: E[l_t(a)|x]=f*(x,a) for some f* in a general value-function class F
access to an online square-loss regression oracle with regret Reg_Sq(T)
loss distributions P_{l_t}(.|x) may vary across rounds, chosen a priori by an oblivious adversary
contexts chosen by an adaptive adversary
settings.definition_quote: At each round $t\in\brk*{T}$, Nature selects a context $x_t\in\cX$ and loss function $\ls_t:\cA\to\brk*{0,1}$, where $\cA=\brk*{K}$ ... We allow the contexts $x_t$ to be chosen arbitrarily by an adaptive adversary, but we assume that each loss $\ls_t$ is drawn independently from a fixed distribution $\bbP_{\ls_t}(\cdot\mid{}x_t)$

settings.name_in_paper: RichCB with i.i.d. contexts and tensorized class with empirical entropy eps^{-p}
unmapped: realizability with general value-function class F = G^K (tensorized)
empirical entropy of base class G grows as eps^{-p}
settings.definition_quote: Contexts and losses are drawn i.i.d. from a joint distribution $\mu$, and there exists a constant $p>0$ such that for all $\veps>0$, the empirical entropy for $\cG$ grows as $\Hiid(\cG,\veps) \lesssim \veps^{-p}$.

settings.name_in_paper: RichCB with i.i.d. contexts, entropy eps^{-p}, two actions (lower bound)
unmapped: realizable, tensorized function class with empirical entropy Theta~(eps^{-p})
settings.definition_quote: there exists a slightly modified class $\cG'$ with $\Hiid(\cG',\veps)=\wt{\Theta}\prn*{\veps^{-p}}$ for which the corresponding function class $\cF$ (with $K=2$) ...

settings.name_in_paper: Realizable noiseless contextual bandit with uniform gap, finite class (lower bound)
unmapped: realizable finite function class F known to learner
uniform gap: f*(x,a)-f*(x,pi*(x)) > Delta for all x and a != pi*(x)
settings.definition_quote: A contextual bandit instance is said to have uniform gap $\Delta$ if for all $x\in\cX$, $\fstar(x,a) - \fstar(x,\pistar(x)) > \Delta\quad\forall{}a\neq{}\pistar(x)$.

settings.name_in_paper: Misspecified contextual bandits (oblivious adversary, eps-approximate realizability)
unmapped: approximate realizability: |f*(x,a) - E[l_t(a)|x]| <= eps for some f* in F
learner needs eps to tune gamma
settings.definition_quote: There exists a regressor $\fstar\in\cF$ such that for all $t$, $\fstar(x,a) = \En\brk*{\ls_t(a)\mid{}x_t=x} + \veps_{t}(x,a)$, where $\abs*{\veps_{t}(x,a)}\leq{}\veps$.

settings.name_in_paper: Contextual bandits with adaptive adversary constrained to be eps-close to F
unmapped: adversary constrained: exists f* in F with |l_t(a) - f*(x_t,a)| <= eps for all a
learner needs eps to tune gamma
settings.definition_quote: The adaptive adversary is constrained such that for every sequence, there exists $\fstar\in\cF$ such that $\abs*{\ls_{t}(a)-\fstar(x_t,a)}\leq\veps$ for all $a\in\cA$.

settings.name_in_paper: Realizable contextual bandits with actions in the d_A-dimensional unit l2 ball
unmapped: regression functions f(x,a)=<f(x),a> with f(x) in unit ball; context-dependent parameter given by general class F
online regression oracle with linear-in-action predictions
loss range not explicitly restated for this section
settings.definition_quote: we extend \mainalg to an infinite-action setting where the action space $\cA$ is $\infdim$-dimensional unit $\ls_2$ ball $\Aball$. ... the regression functions in $\cF$ take the form $f(x,a) = \tri*{f(x),a}$

symbols.Reg_Sq: square-loss regret bound Reg_Sq(T) of the online regression oracle

source.label: thm:reduction_main
source.quote: Suppose \pref{ass:realizability} and Assumption 2a/b hold. Then for any $\delta>0$, by setting $\mu=K$ and $\gamma = \sqrt{KT/\prn{\RegSquare+\log(2\delta^{-1})}}$, \mainalg guarantees that with probability at least $1-\delta$, $\Reg \leq{} 4\sqrt{KT\cdot\RegSquare} + 8\sqrt{KT\log(2\delta^{-1})}$.

results.notes: Regret is realized loss vs pi* = pi_{f*}. Runtime is O(K) oracle calls per round; polynomial relative to oracle. Text instantiations: finite F gives sqrt(KT log|F|), VAW linear gives sqrt(dKT log(T/d)), OGD gives K^{1/2}T^{3/4}, GLM gives sqrt(dKT log T/c_sigma^2).

symbols.p_ent: growth exponent of empirical entropy, H(G,eps) = Theta(eps^{-p})

conditions: base class G has empirical entropy Theta(eps^{-p}); bound holds for a slightly modified class G' with entropy Theta~(eps^{-p})

source.label: thm:lb_stochastic
source.quote: Let $\cG$ be any function class for which $\Hiid(\cG,\veps)=\Theta\prn*{\veps^{-p}}$ for some $p>0$. Then there exists a slightly modified class $\cG'$ with $\Hiid(\cG',\veps)=\wt{\Theta}\prn*{\veps^{-p}}$ for which the corresponding function class $\cF$ (with $K=2$) is such that any algorithm must have $\En\brk*{\Reg}\geq{}\bigomt\prn*{T^{\frac{1+p}{2+p}}}$, on some realizable instance for $\cF$.

results.notes: E[Reg] against pi* equals pseudo-regret. Construction uses Bernoulli losses and i.i.d. uniform contexts.

symbols.p_ent: growth exponent of empirical entropy of base class G, H(G,eps) <~ eps^{-p}

conditions: Assumption 3 (i.i.d. contexts and losses, entropy growth eps^{-p})
tuning: SqAlg = Vovk's aggregating algorithm over empirical covers refreshed on doubling epochs, scale eps ~ (KT)^{-1/(2+p)}

source.label: thm:universal_ub_tensor
source.quote: Whenever \pref{ass:iid_me} holds, there exists a choice for the base regret minimization algorithm \alg such that with probability at least $1-\delta$, \mainalg{} has $\Reg\leq{}\bigoht\prn*{(KT)^{\frac{1+p}{2+p}} + \sqrt{K^{2}T\log(\delta^{-1})}}$.

results.notes: Oracle built from covers is generally not efficient; compute not stated.

conditions: function class F with two arms and |F| <= sqrt(2T)
context set size scales as sqrt(T)

source.label: thm:gap_lb
source.quote: For every $T$, there exists a function class $\cF$ with two arms and $\abs*{\cF}\leq{}\sqrt{2T}$ such that for any (potentially randomized) contextual bandit algorithm, there exists a realizable and noiseless contextual bandit instance with uniform gap $\Delta=\frac{1}{4}$ on which $\En\brk*{\Reg} \geq{} \frac{1}{16}\sqrt{T}$.

results.notes: Rules out regret K log|F|/Delta polylog(T). Contexts are a fixed deterministic sequence.

symbols.Reg_Sq: square-loss regret bound of the online regression oracle

source.label: thm:misspec
source.quote: Suppose the adversary satisfies \pref{ass:misspec} and \alg satisfies \pref{ass:square_regret}. Then \mainalg with $\gamma=2\sqrt{KT/(\RegSquare+2\veps^{2}T)}$ and $\mu=K$ ensures that $\sup_{\pi}\En\brk*{\sum_{t=1}^{T}\ls_t(a_t) - \sum_{t=1}^{T}\ls_t(\pi(x_t))}\leq{} 2\sqrt{KT\cdot{}\RegSquare} + \veps\cdot{}5\sqrt{K}T$, where $\sup_{\pi}$ ranges over all policies

results.notes: Sup over policies outside expectation (pseudo-regret style), against all policies pi: X -> A.

symbols.Reg_Sq: square-loss regret bound of the online regression oracle

conditions: Assumption 5 (adaptive adversary eps-close to some f* in F)

source.label: thm:misspec_adversarial
source.quote: Suppose the adversary satisfies \pref{ass:misspec2} and \alg satisfies \pref{ass:square_regret}. Then \mainalg with $\gamma=\sqrt{8KT/(\RegSquare+\veps^{2}T)}$ and $\mu=K$ ensures that $\sup_{\pi}\En\brk*{\sum_{t=1}^{T}\ls_t(a_t) - \sum_{t=1}^{T}\ls_t(\pi(x_t))}\leq{} \sqrt{2KT\cdot{}\RegSquare} + \veps\cdot\sqrt{2K}T.$

results.notes: With VAW oracle gives O~(sqrt(dKT) + eps sqrt(K) T) for misspecified linear CB.

symbols.Reg_Sq: square-loss regret bound of the online regression oracle

conditions: oracle predictions linear in action: yhat_t(x,a) = <yhat_t(x), a>

source.label: thm:reduction_ball
source.quote: Suppose \pref{ass:realizability} and Assumption 2a/b hold. Then for any $\delta>0$, \infalg with parameter ${\beta = \sqrt{\infdim{}(\RegSquare+8\log(\delta^{-1}))/T}}$ ensures that with probability at least $1-\delta$, $\Reg \leq{} 18\sqrt{\infdim{}T\cdot{}\RegSquare} + 90\sqrt{\infdim{}T\log(\delta^{-1})}$.

results.notes: d is the paper's d_A (dimension of action ball). With VAW gives d*sqrt(T log(T/d)).
